items.title: Introducing GPT-Rosalind for life sciences research
items.title_zh: 推出 GPT-Rosalind：面向生命科学研究的前沿推理模型
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-Rosalind, a frontier reasoning model built to accelerate drug discovery, genomics analysis, protein reasoning and scientific research workflows.

items.title: Codex for (almost) everything
items.title_zh: Codex 升级：几乎什么都能做
items.summary: The updated Codex app for macOS and Windows adds computer use, in-app browsing, image generation, memory and plugins, with the aim of accelerating developer workflows.

items.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: Agentic coding power, now open to all
items.title_zh: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B：Agent 编程能力，向所有人开放
items.summary: Qwen released Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, presented as bringing agentic coding power and now open to all. The accompanying blog lists capabilities spanning chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: DeepER-Med: Advancing Deep Evidence-Based Research in Medicine Through Agentic AI
items.title_zh: DeepER-Med：以智能体 AI 推进医学深度循证研究
items.summary: DeepER-Med frames deep medical research as an explicit, inspectable workflow of research planning, agentic collaboration and evidence synthesis. The authors also release DeepER-MedQA, 100 expert-level questions curated by 11 biomedical experts, and report expert evaluations where it beats production-grade platforms and matches clinical recommendations in seven of eight real-world cases.

items.title: Predict and Reconstruct: Joint Objectives for Self-Supervised Language Representation Learning
items.title_zh: 预测与重建：自监督语言表示学习的联合目标
items.summary: The authors combine a JEPA-style latent-space prediction loss with a standard masked-language-modeling objective over one shared encoder, balanced by a learnable scalar. Pre-trained on English Wikipedia under matched compute, the hybrid encoder produces significantly more uniform embeddings and encodes less surface-level lexical information at similar linear-probe accuracy.

items.title: How Embeddings Shape Graph Neural Networks: Classical vs Quantum-Oriented Node Representations
items.title_zh: 嵌入如何塑造图神经网络：经典与量子取向的节点表示对比
items.summary: A controlled benchmark compares classical and quantum-oriented node embeddings for graph classification under a shared backbone, stratified splits and identical training budgets. Quantum-oriented embeddings show the most consistent gains on structure-driven benchmarks, while social graphs with limited node attributes remain better served by classical baselines.

items.title: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Generation without Taxonomy-based Error Categorization
items.title_zh: 无需基于分类法的错误归类也能改进检索增强生成
items.summary: RePAIR learns a response-to-action mapping that sends flawed RAG outputs directly to error-mitigating action plans, avoiding fine-grained error taxonomies and explicit critic supervision. The authors report consistent gains for agentic RAG across multiple benchmarks.

items.title: MADE: A Living Benchmark for Multi-Label Text Classification with Uncertainty Quantification of Medical Device Adverse Events
items.title_zh: MADE：面向医疗器械不良事件多标签分类与不确定性量化的动态基准
items.summary: MADE is a living multi-label text classification benchmark derived from medical device adverse event reports and continuously updated to prevent contamination. Across more than 20 encoder- and decoder-only models, smaller fine-tuned decoders lead head-to-tail accuracy, generative fine-tuning yields the most reliable uncertainty estimates, and large reasoning models improve rare-label performance but show weak calibration.

items.title: Why Fine-Tuning Encourages Hallucinations and How to Fix It
items.title_zh: 微调为何会加剧幻觉，以及如何修复
items.summary: The authors trace hallucinations introduced by supervised fine-tuning to interference among overlapping semantic representations, and propose a self-distillation SFT method that regularizes output-distribution drift to limit forgetting of pre-trained knowledge. They also find that freezing parameter groups can preserve task performance while reducing hallucinations when new knowledge does not need to be acquired.

items.title: vstash: Local-First Hybrid Retrieval with Adaptive Fusion for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: vstash：面向 LLM 智能体的本地优先自适应混合检索
items.summary: vstash is a local-first document memory system that keeps data in one SQLite file and fuses vector search with FTS5 keyword matching through reciprocal rank fusion and adaptive per-query IDF weighting. On five BEIR datasets, disagreement-driven embedding refinement and adaptive fusion improve NDCG@10, and the tuned 33M-parameter BGE-small pipeline matches or exceeds published ColBERTv2 and BGE-base results on three of five datasets.

items.title: "Excuse me, may I say something..." CoLabScience, A Proactive AI Assistant for Biomedical Discovery and LLM-Expert Collaborations
items.title_zh: 「打扰一下，我能说两句吗……」CoLabScience：面向生物医学发现与 LLM-专家协作的主动式助手
items.summary: CoLabScience is a proactive LLM assistant for biomedical collaboration built on PULI, an RL-trained framework that decides when and how to intervene in streaming scientific discussions using the team's proposal and conversational memory. The authors also introduce BSDD, a benchmark of simulated research dialogues with intervention points derived from PubMed articles.

items.title: ciembor/agent-rules-books
items.title_zh: ciembor/agent-rules-books：取材经典编程书的 Agent 规则集
items.summary: A collection of AGENTS.md rules and skills for AI coding agents such as Codex, Cursor and Claude Code, drawing on programming books including Clean Code, Refactoring, Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture and Designing Data-Intensive Applications.

items.title: Laravel raised money and now injects ads directly into your agent
items.title_zh: Laravel 融资后直接把广告塞进你的 Agent
items.summary: According to the article, Laravel Boost now tells AI coding agents that Laravel Cloud is the best deployment option and does not mention alternatives, raising the question of whether this is the future of advertising aimed at agents.
